episodes.title: Odcinek 1
episodes.summary: After an unfortunate run in with some of the Kosynierzy men, Kuba is lured into the security and camaraderie of Zyga's inner circle.

episodes.title: Odcinek 2
episodes.summary: Michał begins to suspect that Kuba's loyalty to his club may get him into a spiral of trouble, while Justyna has a score to settle with a DNA test.

episodes.title: Odcinek 3
episodes.summary: Recovering from his injury, Kuba struggles to separate the club from the man, and Michał fears for the safety of his family when the police come knocking.

episodes.title: Odcinek 4
episodes.summary: When Kuba's new allegiance to Kosynierzy comes under question, he must prove to them that he is truly one of their own… no matter the consequences.

episodes.title: Odcinek 5
episodes.summary: In the wake of tragedy, Justyna reaches out to Blanka hoping to right the mess that Kuba finds himself tangled in – before it's too late.
